upcoming.notes: Named as OpenAI's next major model family on 1 Aug 2026 alongside ten claimed open-problem results with Lean 4 certificates (github.com/openai/ten-proofs), at roughly $2,000 in tokens at GPT-5.6 Sol rates. On 7 Aug 2026 OpenAI disclosed it had paused select internal Astra work to expand cybersecurity safeguards after preliminary evaluations could not rule out a Critical agentic capability threshold under its Preparedness Framework. Naming undecided: may ship as GPT-6, as a GPT-5 point release, or as Astra. Not to be confused with Google DeepMind's Project Astra, a separate and unrelated product. Verified via Noam Brown and Greg Brockman (OpenAI), Techmeme and Simon Willison; openai.com returns 403 to automated fetch, so the announcement page itself was not read directly.
